title: CanIToolCall run results
description: Output of `canitoolcall run --engine E`: one file per engine run, written to results/<engine>-<engine_version>.json. The matrix site is built ONLY from these files.

name.description: Adapter name: vllm, sglang, llamacpp, ollama, transformers, mlx_lm, or an out-of-tree adapter's name.

version.description: Version actually imported/built (e.g. 0.30.0 or a git sha).

details.description: Adapter-specific pins: key dependency versions, build flags, harness sha.

fixtures_digest.description: sha256 over the sorted fixture ids and their canonical JSON.

synthetic_strategies.description: Strategies that ran but do not count toward case status for this engine: char:<seed> always, and multi-token strategies (one, special, rand:<seed>:<max> with max > 1) for engines whose server streams one token per event (engine.details.tokens_per_step = "one").

normalization.description: Name of the normalization policy used for soft comparisons (see spec/README.md).

arguments_raw.description: Arguments exactly as the engine returned them (JSON text in OpenAI format; null if the engine returned none, which the checks report as invalid).

exception.description: "ExcType: message" if the ENGINE's parser raised.

status.description: Worst status over the checks of realistic strategies (fail > error > soft_pass > pass); synthetic rows (run.synthetic_strategies) are reported but never counted. unsupported if the adapter does not support the family/model.

reason.description: Why the adapter declined the family/model (status unsupported).

parser_config.description: Exact parser configuration used (parser names, template source + sha256, reasoning/thinking flags, tokenizer mode).

skipped_strategies.description: Requested chunking strategies the worker could not run for this case, with the reason (e.g. special when the adapter does not expose special token ids).

observed.description: Raw observations; runners include them at least for non-pass cases so failures are reproducible.

harness_error.description: Set when status is error: the ADAPTER/harness failed (not the engine parser).
